caption: Depiction labelled Qawoun (melon, Cucumis melo). From Kitab al-Hasha'ish fi Hayula al-‘Ilaj al-Tibbi (Arabic translation of Dioscorides’ De Materia Medica, edited by Abu ‘Abdallah al-Natili, approx. 990) and copied in Samarqand, 1082. Rpt. Harry S. Paris, et al. “Medieval emergence of sweet melons, Cucumis melo (Cucurbitaceae).” Annals of Botany 110.1 (May 2012): 23-33.
alt: A painting from an Arabic herbal of a melon plant: twining blue-grey stems curving into a symmetrical pattern, with dark lobed leaves and round yellow melons, labelled in Arabic script.
bibliography: "Qawoun (Melon, Cucumis melo)." Kitāb al-Ḥashā’ish fī hayūlā al-‘ilāj al-ṭibbī, copied in Samarqand, 1082. Reproduced in Harry S. Paris et al., "Medieval Emergence of Sweet Melons, Cucumis melo (Cucurbitaceae)," Annals of Botany, vol. 110, no. 1, May 2012, pp. 23–33.

edition.title: Medieval Emergence of Sweet Melons, Cucumis melo (Cucurbitaceae)
